title: HONEYBEE AUDIT — green→purple→green→purple, what's connected, what's orphaned

the_bee_sees.orphan_rate: 91% of pages have NO inbound link from index.html

engines_audit.observation: 153 engines but most are standalone — not wired into the HUD monolith

data_audit.taxonomy_template: 81KB — 118 elements, each with chemistry/etymology/organism/physics/art/fermentation fields. MOST are unfilled.
data_audit.observation: The taxonomy template IS the education system — it has slots for everything but most are empty

root_json_audit.tiny_stubs_note: 42 files are <50 bytes — just pointers or empty shells. These are the SEEDS that never grew.

api_audit.observation: The API layer exists but nothing in the HUD reads most of it

phase_1_link_orphans.what: 133 orphan HTML pages need to be reachable from the HUD
phase_1_link_orphans.how: The taxonomic tree (118 elements) maps to pages. Each element links to relevant pages.
phase_1_link_orphans.saves: No pages deleted — they become CURRICULUM in the AI Arena University

phase_2_wire_engines.what: 153 JS modules mostly standalone — wire key ones into the HUD
phase_2_wire_engines.how: The 4 stubs (globe.js, sensors.js, effects.js, canvas-view.js) become real module loaders

phase_3_fill_taxonomy.what: taxonomy-template.json has 118 elements with empty organism/art/fermentation slots
phase_3_fill_taxonomy.how: Map data files to elements. Each data file IS a lesson. Completeness score drives curriculum.
phase_3_fill_taxonomy.target: Every element has at least organism mapping + one art piece + fermentation score

phase_4_zk_hammer.what: Everything remaining gets ZK-proved: hash every file, build Merkle tree, anchor to identity seed
phase_4_zk_hammer.how: ZK proof = the organism KNOWS what it has. Nothing hidden. Full accounting.
